Source-install correction: Use version 0.2.1 or later for a Git-backed marketplace installation. The 0.2.0 ZIP contains the complete widget, but its Git tag omitted the nested rendered widget because of an ignore rule. The patch preserves widget behavior and all thirteen procedures.

Thirteen visualization workflows and a local interactive Data Explorer with transparent calculations.

Version 0.2.0 includes 13 complete skill procedures. Complete original workflows, runtime and MIT/Apache methods; proprietary Visualize and unlicensed Scientific source libraries excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared MCP dependencies; MCP Apps supporting host for the widget.

License scope: MIT AND Apache-2.0; retained dependency notices. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add data-visualization-toolkit@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 65519bccb27654c9cc9bfd1878ed0084b48316a9. SHA-256: 50d9b82fe75c477fff18a0036f4ab543c302acef13a093502d300dce19995f00.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
